Property.name: SnipWorkflow
Property.Description:
Workflow For SNIP errors flag
Turn on and off sending SNIP errors to workflow

Off by default as we only want to send to workflow if users plan on working the errors

Property.name: TpCheckBeforeOverwrite
Property.Description:
Flag that causes the code to check for a TP link from the X12 Data before doing any other logic tp loop up logic including the overwite
When set tries to find a TP link using the values from the X12 first and then only runs the overwrite logic if no TP link is found from the values in the X12
When not set run the overwrite logic and checks the Partner lookup table before trying to find a TP link

Off by default as we don't want the overhead of posibly checking for the TP link twice if we now that the X12 data will not have exact TP link matches

Property.name: OriginalPathParentFolderForTpOverwrite
Property.Description:
Directory name to search for in OriginalFilename for use in the TP overwrite logic and lookup table.
When not blank, uses this string to search for a directory in the OriginalFilename and use that to set the TP Link logic
